# Vendored third-party code

| Directory | Project | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tl-expected/` | [TartanLlama/expected](https://github.com/TartanLlama/expected) (`include/tl/expected.hpp` only) | 1.1.0 | CC0 1.0 (`tl-expected/COPYING`) |

The build prefers an installed `tl-expected` package (vcpkg or system) and falls back to this copy.
